routingRules: Every return matches the exact requesting operation and agent; never broadcast a result to every outgoing edge.
Contribution edges stage versioned dependency data; they do not advance execution cursor.
Observation edges report safe events without scheduling work.
Same-named event kinds may target different requesters only through correlated return routing.
New failed/refused/unavailable output variants with no continuation are explicit local terminal or retained outputs, not silent omissions.
A wait registration is a side notification; OAuth or prompt workflows start only through their single owning request path. Register the wait before external answers can arrive.
Safety denial/evaluation failure passes through authorize to the correlated requester without creating a grant.
Model terminal publication replaces its old facade bypass; never emit two terminal Decide events.
Future child permission waits retain owningNodeId and child spawn operation so they cannot be routed as ordinary tool approval answers.
Operation wait expiry returns only to that operation owner; it is not automatically turn Stop.
Every delegated request must return failure/refusal/unavailable as well as success to its requester; local terminal outputs alone cannot settle a parent operation.
Input delivery request, provider receipt and Output status have distinct direction discriminators.
Output owns authentication waits for retained delivery after execution completion; these do not keep a completed agent turn artificially active.
Environment bind can return a handle to Computer or run a matching Tools operation; return routing follows the request discriminator.
Memory responses preserve Context/Tools/maintenance requester and operation identity; State acknowledgments do not repeat semantic extraction or external effects.
Memory forgetting revokes recall before covered cleanup; derived indexes are not authoritative records and pending consolidation cannot recreate revoked content.
reviewNotes: Supporting audits specify fields and fixtures; complete per-node schemas are an implementation checklist item.

Future nodes remain unavailable until their design/playback slice is implemented.

traceSubscriptions.rule: Safe lifecycle events are observed without serializing the main request through telemetry.
